correctness.rationale: The Petersen KG(5,2) graph has fifteen edges. Independent disjoint-set forest predicate on all 1024 masks gives 785 nonempty allowed faces f=(10,45,120,210,240,140,20), with matching 389 pairs and a complete acyclic topological sort of 3470 covering arrows on 785 cells. Critical cells are one 0-cell and six 5-cells, so Forman directly gives integral wedge^6 S5. Signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz traces for every S5 permutation agree with the exterior-square character: classes of cycle type 1^5,2,2^2,3,3x2,4,5 have values (6,0,-2,0,0,0,1); the irreducible six-dimensional wedge^2 of standard V follows by its character norm 1.
